metadata.title: Pilots Fixing a Navigation Fault Didn't Notice the Dive
metadata.description:
Adam Air 574 dove into the sea off Sulawesi. The cause: autopilot disengagement while the crew was distracted, leading to an unrecovered spiral dive.

Failure chain: Recurring navigation fault → Both pilots troubleshoot → Autopilot disengages → Slow roll unnoticed → Spiral dive

Related episode: Two Jumbo Jets, One Runway, and a Misunderstood Word — https://youtu.be/PlQYe5W0szE

Series — Aviation Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHIwDgtDRNyY
